decision.reason: Official 정보공시 leaves are 전문대학/대학교/국외진학/취업자/기타. openData TOTAL3–8 are 6 fields because TOTAL5+TOTAL6 are 국외진학 subtypes that always equal OUT_TOT_SUM; product shows one 국외진학 leaf. TOT_SUM always equals TOTAL3+…+TOTAL6 (진학자). T3=전문대학 / T4=대학교 locked by official form order + vocational vs academic share patterns.

fiveVsSixResolution.explanation: TOTAL5 and TOTAL6 are subtypes under 국외진학. Empirically OUT_TOT_SUM === TOTAL5+TOTAL6 for all 2074 rows with TOTAL2>0. Product binds 국외진학 = TOTAL5+TOTAL6.
ruledOut: TOTAL2 is not a leaf among TOTAL3–8 (TOTAL2 is graduates; sum(TOTAL3..8)=TOTAL2)
No extra 미상 leaf beyond 기타 (TOTAL8)
TOT_SUM is 진학자 subtotal (T3..T6), not an extra leaf

TOTAL3.evidence: Official form order first domestic leaf; 특성화/폴리텍 mean T3>T4; 일반고 mean T3=15.8% < T4=64.2%

TOTAL4.evidence: Official form second domestic leaf; academic/특목 mean T4 dominant

TOTAL5.evidence: Part of OUT_TOT_SUM; rarer alone than TOTAL6

TOTAL6.evidence: Part of OUT_TOT_SUM; most common sole overseas field

국외진학.evidence: Official leaf; OUT_* fields; TOT_SUM includes overseas with domestic

TOTAL7.evidence: Official leaf after 국외; elevated at vocational/special schools

TOTAL8.evidence: Official final leaf; large at competitive general HS (재수학년 해석은 제품 비표시)
